name: The East India Company's 'factory' in Canton (Guangzhou)
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the porticoes of the English and Dutch 'factories' (trading bases) seen from Chungqua's hong to the west. On the back is a view of the site of the foreign 'factories' from the river to the south-east.
